name: Fey Goblin
body:
Long ago, some goblins were tricked into making bargains with the fey that they could never fully repay. Having pledged their loyalty to fey royalty for all eternity, these goblins were themselves transformed into fey creatures. Rather than the usual green, these fey goblins took on a lighter, yellow or orange complexion. Their faces took on an elongated, pixielike quality, their nose and ears growing long and pointed.

Where standard goblins are able to find some joy in community, song, and general mischief, the lives of fey goblins are filled with nothing but frustration and anger. They are angry at their lot in life, and the unbreakable curse that binds them to their fey king and queen.

Core Traits
Fey Heritage Your type is fey instead of humanoid; you retain the goblinoid subtype.
Senses You gain low-light vision, and your ability score adjustments are +2 Dex, +2 Wis, –2 Str. This trait alters your type and ability scores.
Fey Skills Traits You gain a +4 species bonus on all Stealth checks, as well as on Acrobatics checks made to avoid an attack of opportunity when moving through an opponent’s threatened area. This trait replaces skilled.
Alternate Species Traits
Blessings of the Fey King You are proficient with the scimitar, shortbow, and shortsword. Once per day when you cause hit point damage to an opponent with an attack or a spell, you can deal an additional amount of damage to that creature equal to your character level. This trait replaces darkvision.
Blessings of the Fey Queen If your Charisma score is at least 11, you can use the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—bungle, mudball, and spark. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level, and Charisma is your casting ability. This trait replaces darkvision.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
